description: This file defines the Pagination class in the Opencart admin controller namespace. It provides logic to generate pagination links for the admin interface, including calculating page ranges, previous/next links, and rendering the view.

classes.name: Pagination
classes.description: Controller class responsible for generating pagination data for display in the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates pagination links based on provided settings, returning the rendered pagination view or an empty string if not needed.
